source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 сентября ст. ст. — «Прп. Силуана Афонского (1938)»

attestations.note: Not checked: saint.gr was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026; its page for this day was not read (2026-08-30).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026 (10 August – 6 September ст. ст.); its page for this day was not read (2026-08-30).

birth.note: The life on doxologia.ro: born in 1866 to a Russian peasant family, in the world Simeon Ivanovich Antonov.

death.note: The life on doxologia.ro: he died between one and two in the night of 24 September 1938, while Matins was sung in the infirmary chapel; the Russian line prints the same year.
